newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares up, but await technical correction.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares up, but await technical correction.

text.p: Slovenian shares firmed 1.1 percent on foreign buying on Monday but traders said a technical correction was possible later in the week.

"Demand is still high but today's relatively small gain shows there has already been some profit taking which could lead to a downward technical correction this week," said Zoran Spasinic, a trader at brokerage BPH.
* The SBI index rose 14.6 points to 1,337.4.
* Bank SKB was most actively traded, closing 0.61 percent higer at 49,300 tolars on volume of 3,106 shares. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386-61-126-3644
